research_task.title: Replay a supplied immutable nine-cell eta bundle

summary: Bounded negative reproducibility result: the permitted payload contains no candidate historical nine-cell eta bundle, so none of its declared margins, statuses, ownership cases, or malformed fixtures can be replayed in this attempt.

value_assessment.novelty: Relative to the linked prior review, this independently reproduces the missing-payload observation in a new attempt and adds a SHA-256-identified, script-generated inventory; it neither reproduces nor contradicts the unseen nine-cell outcomes.
value_assessment.evidence: A recursive hidden-inclusive inventory and a newly written read-only audit found one supplied file of 9,643 bytes with SHA-256 bf0ab243d5665994153bf2423c377c095bc9ae965313132185bec10befffaee2, zero candidate bundle files, and replay readiness false.
value_assessment.falsifier: Discovery in the permitted attempt payload of any additional pre-existing certificate, manifest, declared-output, ownership, or malformed-fixture artifact would overturn the absence claim and require replay.

claims.statement: At audit time, the supplied payload for this bounded attempt contained only the required research brief and no candidate historical nine-cell bundle input.
claims.evidence_summary: The initial recursive inventory distinguished the three just-created outputs from the brief, and the purpose-built audit reported one supplied file, zero candidate inputs, and replay readiness false.
claims.verification_method: Run the read-only recursive audit in the same preserved attempt payload and compare the supplied-file count, byte length, SHA-256 digest, candidate count, and readiness flag.

limitations: The claim concerns only the permitted local payload at audit time and says nothing about files elsewhere or historical existence.
No rational margin, cell status, grid coverage rule, ownership outcome, malformed fixture, or analytic eta bound was independently checked.
Prior-artifact excerpts are unreviewed summaries and were not treated as replay inputs.
This result neither locates an off-critical-line zero nor establishes a zero-free region.
failed_approaches: The requested exact-integer replay could not start because the certificate data, declared output, ownership probes, and malformed fixtures were absent.
next_actions: Obtain an immutable archive or manifest containing all historical replay inputs and publisher-recorded SHA-256 digests, then perform a clean-room exact-integer replay.

proposed_tasks.title: Replay the recovered nine-cell eta bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: Verify publisher-recorded hashes and independently check every normalized rational margin, declared cell status, boundary owner, and malformed-fixture outcome.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The current review establishes only that the required historical bytes are absent from its payload; supplying them resolves the precise obstruction.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: A clean-room exact-integer checker reproduces all declared outcomes and exhaustively checks endpoints, shared edges, and corners against hash-verified inputs.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Preserve the first hash, schema, fraction, status, coverage, ownership, or malformed-fixture disagreement as a minimal failing certificate.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Treat the archive as untrusted data, verify SHA-256 before parsing, normalize every rational, and decide all comparisons only by integer signs and exact cross-products.
